work.title: The First Part of King Henry the Fourth
work.author: William Shakespeare

scene.label: Act 4, Scene 4
scene.title: SCENE IV. York. A Room in the Archbishop's Palace.
scene.location: York. A Room in the Archbishop's Palace.

content.text: Enter the Archbishop of York and Sir Michael.

lines.text: Hie, good Sir Michael; bear this sealed brief
lines.plainText: Hie good Sir Michael bear this sealed brief

lines.text: With winged haste to the Lord Marshal,
lines.plainText: With winged haste to the Lord Marshal

lines.text: This to my cousin Scroop, and all the rest
lines.plainText: This to my cousin Scroop and all the rest

lines.text: To whom they are directed. If you knew
lines.plainText: To whom they are directed If you knew

lines.text: How much they do import, you would make haste.
lines.plainText: How much they do import you would make haste

lines.text: My good lord,
lines.plainText: My good lord

lines.text: I guess their tenour.
lines.plainText: I guess their tenour

lines.text: Like enough you do.
lines.plainText: Like enough you do

lines.text: Tomorrow, good Sir Michael, is a day
lines.plainText: Tomorrow good Sir Michael is a day

lines.text: Wherein the fortune of ten thousand men
lines.plainText: Wherein the fortune of ten thousand men

lines.text: Must bide the touch; for, sir, at Shrewsbury,
lines.plainText: Must bide the touch for sir at Shrewsbury

lines.text: As I am truly given to understand,
lines.plainText: As I am truly given to understand

lines.text: The King with mighty and quick-raised power
lines.plainText: The King with mighty and quickraised power

lines.text: Meets with Lord Harry. And, I fear, Sir Michael,
lines.plainText: Meets with Lord Harry And I fear Sir Michael

lines.text: What with the sickness of Northumberland,
lines.plainText: What with the sickness of Northumberland

lines.text: Whose power was in the first proportion,
lines.plainText: Whose power was in the first proportion

lines.text: And what with Owen Glendower's absence thence,
lines.plainText: And what with Owen Glendower's absence thence

lines.text: Who with them was a rated sinew too,
lines.plainText: Who with them was a rated sinew too

lines.text: And comes not in, o'er-rul'd by prophecies,
lines.plainText: And comes not in o'errul'd by prophecies

lines.text: I fear the power of Percy is too weak
lines.plainText: I fear the power of Percy is too weak

lines.text: To wage an instant trial with the King.
lines.plainText: To wage an instant trial with the King

lines.text: Why, my good lord, you need not fear,
lines.plainText: Why my good lord you need not fear

lines.text: There is Douglas and Lord Mortimer.
lines.plainText: There is Douglas and Lord Mortimer

lines.text: No, Mortimer is not there.
lines.plainText: No Mortimer is not there

lines.text: But there is Mordake, Vernon, Lord Harry Percy,
lines.plainText: But there is Mordake Vernon Lord Harry Percy

lines.text: And there is my Lord of Worcester, and a head
lines.plainText: And there is my Lord of Worcester and a head

lines.text: Of gallant warriors, noble gentlemen.
lines.plainText: Of gallant warriors noble gentlemen

lines.text: And so there is. But yet the King hath drawn
lines.plainText: And so there is But yet the King hath drawn

lines.text: The special head of all the land together:
lines.plainText: The special head of all the land together

lines.text: The Prince of Wales, Lord John of Lancaster,
lines.plainText: The Prince of Wales Lord John of Lancaster

lines.text: The noble Westmoreland, and warlike Blunt,
lines.plainText: The noble Westmoreland and warlike Blunt

lines.text: And many more corrivals and dear men
lines.plainText: And many more corrivals and dear men

lines.text: Of estimation and command in arms.
lines.plainText: Of estimation and command in arms

lines.text: Doubt not, my lord, they shall be well opposed.
lines.plainText: Doubt not my lord they shall be well opposed

lines.text: I hope no less, yet needful 'tis to fear;
lines.plainText: I hope no less yet needful 'tis to fear

lines.text: And to prevent the worst, Sir Michael, speed.
lines.plainText: And to prevent the worst Sir Michael speed

lines.text: For if Lord Percy thrive not, ere the King
lines.plainText: For if Lord Percy thrive not ere the King

lines.text: Dismiss his power he means to visit us,
lines.plainText: Dismiss his power he means to visit us

lines.text: For he hath heard of our confederacy,
lines.plainText: For he hath heard of our confederacy

lines.text: And 'tis but wisdom to make strong against him.
lines.plainText: And 'tis but wisdom to make strong against him

lines.text: Therefore make haste. I must go write again
lines.plainText: Therefore make haste I must go write again

lines.text: To other friends; and so, farewell, Sir Michael.
lines.plainText: To other friends and so farewell Sir Michael
